blurbs.math: Counting, adding, fractions, and up to algebra. We use real-life examples and lots of practice.
blurbs.reading: Sounding out words, reading faster, and understanding stories and articles.
blurbs.writing: Sentences, paragraphs, essays, and spelling. We help kids share their ideas clearly.

sessionSteps: We say hi and check in on how school is going (5 minutes).
We work on the skill or homework your child needs most (40 minutes).

how.title: How It Works
how.intro: Everything you need to know, in plain words.

faq.a: Nothing. Tutoring is free. We will never ask for a credit card.
Any student in grades K–12. You do not need to live in a certain neighborhood.
Their homework, a pencil, and any school papers they are stuck on. For online sessions, a phone, tablet, or computer with a camera is best.
After you book, the tutor adds a video link (Google Meet or Zoom) to your booking. Open your dashboard a few minutes early and tap the link. A parent should be home and nearby.
At a public place like a library. Never at someone's home. The address is on your booking.

faq.q: What if my child is really struggling?
faq.a: That is okay. That is why we are here. Ask for a free first meeting. The tutor will see where your child is and make a plan. We go at your child's pace.

faq.q: My child has a learning difference. Can you help?
faq.a: Yes. Tell us what works for your child in the booking note. We can go slower, read questions out loud, and take breaks. We are not special education teachers, but we will do our best and listen to you.
Open your dashboard and tap Cancel on the session. Please cancel at least 12 hours before. Things happen — if you are late or miss one, you can always book again.

faq.q: How do you keep kids safe?
faq.a: Parents can see everything. Tutors cannot send private messages to kids. In-person sessions are in public places. Read our Child Safety page for more.
Our tutors speak English. [PLACEHOLDER: list other languages your tutors speak.] This website is in English and Spanish.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This page explains, in plain words, what information we collect, why, who can see it, and how to delete it.

items: Parent or guardian: name, email, and password.
Student: first name or nickname, grade, and subjects they need help with.
Learning work: session notes, assignments, quiz answers, and photos of homework your child uploads.
Tutor: name, email, short bio, and photo (tutors are adults or high school volunteers).
No birthdays, home addresses, school names, or photos of students.
No credit card numbers. Tutoring is free.
No ad trackers or Facebook pixels. We do not sell your data. Ever.
To schedule sessions and send you reminders.
So tutors know what your child needs help with.
So you can see your child's progress.
You can see all of your family's information.
Your child's tutor can see your child's information. Other tutors cannot.
Our admins (the founders) can see everything to keep the program running safely.
We use Supabase to store data and Resend to send emails. They keep it secure and do not use it for anything else.
Children under 13 cannot make their own account. A parent or guardian must create it.
Parents can see, change, download, or delete their child's information at any time.

sections.h: How to download or delete your data
items: Log in, open your dashboard, and choose "My family's data".
Tap Download to get a copy. Tap Delete to erase everything. Deleting cannot be undone.
Or email us and we will do it for you within 7 days.
We only use cookies to keep you logged in and remember your language. No tracking cookies.
Email us any time. Our address is at the bottom of every page.

safety.title: Child Safety
safety.intro: Keeping kids safe is the most important thing we do. Here is how.

items: Only a parent or guardian can create an account and add a child.
Parents can see everything their child sees: sessions, notes, assignments, and quiz results.
Tutors cannot send private messages to students.
Tutors share session notes that parents can always read, and they email parents — not kids.
Every tutor must be approved by our team before they can see any student.
Tutors can only see the students they work with.
[PLACEHOLDER] Describe any background checks or training your tutors complete.
In-person sessions happen in public places like libraries — never in a home.
For online sessions, a parent or guardian should be home and nearby.
Video links only appear for the booked family and tutor.
We only ask for a child's first name or nickname, grade, and subjects.
We do not collect student photos, birthdays, addresses, or school names.
Email us right away. We take every concern seriously.
If a child is in danger, call 911. To report abuse in Michigan, call 855-444-3911 (Centralized Intake, 24/7).

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.intro: We want everyone to be able to use this website, including people with disabilities.

items: We follow the WCAG 2.1 AA guidelines.
You can use the whole site with only a keyboard.
The site works with screen readers like VoiceOver and TalkBack.
Tap the "Easier reading" button at the top for bigger text and more spacing.
Quizzes have a "Read aloud" button that reads questions out loud.
Colors have strong contrast, and color is never the only way we show something.

sections.h: Works on phones and slow internet
items: The site is built for phones first and uses very little data.
If your internet drops while filling out a form, what you typed is saved on your phone.
If something is hard to use, please email us. Tell us what page and what happened. We will fix it.
